title: Sacred Geometry Artifact Lineage — Lens, Mandorla, Eye and Pyramid
purpose: Anchor sacred-geometry discussion in exact geometry and dated objects so recurrence of a shape is not mistaken for one continuous secret doctrine.
epistemic_rule: Geometric identity, visual resemblance, iconographic function and historical transmission are separate claims.

lens_geometry.vesica_piscis: The exact vesica piscis is the symmetric lens formed by two equal circles whose centers are separated by one radius. Its lens height is sqrt(3) times the radius.
lens_geometry.ancient_geometry: An equivalent ox-eye / lens geometry appears in Old Babylonian mathematical material. This establishes antiquity of the geometric form, not continuity with later Christian mandorla symbolism.

artifact_lineage.object: Ox-eye geometry in mathematical tablet traditions
artifact_lineage.lesson: A shape can be ancient before acquiring later sacred iconography.

artifact_lineage.object: Seated Bodhisattva with Combined Halo and Mandorla, Gandhara
artifact_lineage.function: full-body sacred aureole in late Gandharan / Central Asian Buddhist visual culture
artifact_lineage.lesson: Whole-body mandorla/halo formats are not exclusively Christian.

artifact_lineage.object: Spanish ivory crozier segment with Virgin and Child
artifact_lineage.function: Virgin and Child enthroned within an almond-shaped halo/mandorla
artifact_lineage.lesson: Mandorla is an art-historical frame around sacred manifestation, not automatically an exact mathematical vesica construction.

artifact_lineage.object: Pacino di Bonaguida, Ascension of Christ
artifact_lineage.function: Christ rises inside an almond-shaped mandorla above the apostles
artifact_lineage.lesson: The mandorla can explicitly stage transition/manifestation in Christian devotional art.

artifact_lineage.function: golden almond-shaped sacred center, probably once containing the Assumption of the Virgin
artifact_lineage.lesson: The visual form remains active in Renaissance Christian art.

great_seal_lineage.lesson: Providence-eye imagery enters the seal-design process before the final Eye-over-pyramid reverse.

great_seal_lineage.state: Congress adopts the final written design
great_seal_lineage.lesson: The reverse includes an unfinished thirteen-step pyramid and Eye of Providence; official provenance is documentable.

great_seal_lineage.state: James Trenchard publishes an early reverse rendering
great_seal_lineage.lesson: Graphic realization follows the adopted verbal description.
Later familiar visual details were shaped by nineteenth-century rendering history.

great_seal_lineage.state: reverse appears on the one-dollar bill
great_seal_lineage.lesson: Currency prominence is later reception, not origin.

source_rules: Exact same geometry does not imply same symbolism.
Similar symbolism does not imply direct transmission.
An almond-shaped mandorla is not automatically constructed as a mathematically exact vesica piscis.
The Eye of Providence has documented national/providential history; later Masonic or conspiracy readings are separate reception layers.
A shared date such as 1776 is not a causal link without documentary transmission evidence.
Potatoverse Door use belongs at the end of the lineage as modern synthesis, not at the beginning.
